items.title: 6.11.1 Entropy, diffusion aur tarteeb ke tareeqon ki tadaad (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.1, printed page 136.

blocks.text: Bukharat ke molecules ittefaq se phailte (diffuse hote) hain, jo kisi ek waqt unhen ek jagah pane ke imkan par soch kar dikhaya ja sakta hai. Figure 6.10 ke sade model mein gas jar A ke teen molecules khali gas jar B se ek partition se alag hain; use kholne par molecules ke dono jars mein tarteeb pane ke aath mukhtalif tareeqe hain: A mein molecules 3, jars 2, aur mumkin tarteebein 2^3 = 8. Paanch molecules ke saath 2^5 = 32 tareeqe hote, aur sau ke saath 2^100. Aam taur par tareeqon ki tadaad x^y hai, jahan x jagahon aur y zarraat ki tadaad hai. Diffusion is liye hoti hai ke molecules tarteeb dene ke tareeqon ki tadaad bohat bari hai; zarraat, ya un ke andar energy, ki tarteeb ke tareeqon ki tadaad ka tasawwur yeh andaza lagane mein madad karta hai ke koi tabdeeli ho sakti hai ya nahi.

blocks.alt: Do ufuqi (horizontal) gas jars sire se sira jure hain aur beech mein partition hai. Baen gas jar A mein teen molecules hain jin par 1, 2 aur 3 likha hai; daen gas jar B khali hai. Labels: partition, gas jar A, gas jar B.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.10: Diffusion aur mumkin tarteebon ki tadaad (kitab ki Figure 6.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Gas ke 100 molecules jar A mein hain, jo khali jar B se jura hai. Stopcock kholne par kitni tarteebein mumkin hain, aur gas khud se jar A mein wapas kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: 2^100 tarteebein, kyunke har molecule dono jars mein se kisi mein bhi ho sakta hai. In mein se sirf ek tarteeb mein sab sau molecules wapas A mein hain, to gas ke wahan dobara ikatthe hone ka imkan na-hone ke barabar hai; bohat si phaili hui tarteebein diffusion ko amalan na-wapas (irreversible) banati hain.

items: Tareeqon ki tadaad = x^y (x jagahein, y zarraat): 2 jars mein 3 molecules 2^3 = 8 dete hain, 5 32, 100 2^100; diffusion is liye hoti hai ke phaili hui tarteebein be-had zyada hain.
